d:
Thillu Mullu Tamil Movie Songs HD, Raagangal Pathinaaru Video Song featuring Rajinikanth and Madhavi on Mango Music Tamil. Music by M S Viswanathan and directed by K Balachander. Thillu Mullu movie also stars Kamal Haasan, Lakshmi and Prathap K Pothan in guest roles.
Song: Raagangal Pathinaaru
Singer: SP Balasubramaniam
Thillu Mullu also stars Thengai Srinivasan, Nagesh, Sowcar Janaki, Poornam Viswanathan among others. The film is produced by PR Govindarajan and J. Duraisamy.
